en: A black-and-white postcard showing three notable buildings: a large, ornate two-story school building on the left, a tall clock tower in the center, and another elegant structure on the right. The architecture features arched windows and decorative details. The buildings are set against a backdrop of hills or mountains. The bottom of the postcard has a caption in Romanian.
